_comment: Red-MOT stage: broadband red MOT + compression sweep + single-frequency stage. This selects WHICH variables M-LOOP optimizes; every name in param_names must be a key in TransferOptimizer.DEFAULTS. Bounds below are FILLERS bracketing the DEFAULTS values — TIGHTEN to SAFE hardware ranges before running. The four arrays (param_names/first_params/min_boundary/max_boundary) MUST stay index-aligned and equal length.
_units: freq_* / span_* / sf_freq / rmot_scan_frequency in Hz; rmot_*_current in A (<7); durations in seconds; atten_ramp_* in DAC volts (0-9.99); sf_atten in dB (Urukul RF atten, 0-30); ramp_tau dimensionless.
_notes: span_i/span_f are the modulation depth BELOW the swept top (freq_high_i->freq_high_f); the compressed 'bottom' is (top - span). The single-frequency stage is one tone (sf_freq/sf_atten), held for rmot_sf_duration. 15 params is high-dimensional for a GP — trim param_names (and the aligned arrays) to a subset to converge faster; the driver handles any length.
